bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary canvas, card surfaces, button text, input fills

graphite-ink.$description: Graphite Ink — Primary borders, hairline dividers, link underlines, heading accents

deep-coal.$description: Deep Coal — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Body and heading text at maximum weight, dark hero overlays, icon strokes

press-black.$description: Press Black — Hardest text and button fills where pure black is needed for contrast over warm photography

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary body text, helper copy, muted icon strokes

fog.$description: Fog — Disabled button borders, low-emphasis outlines, decorative hairlines

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Badge fills, input borders, tag backgrounds — the lightest non-canvas neutral

cloud.$description: Cloud — Elevated card backgrounds, subtle surface lift above the canvas

slate.$description: Slate — Mid-weight button borders, heavy outlines on dark surfaces

gestura-custom-serif.$description: Display and editorial headlines. The serif is the brand's single most recognizable choice — it converts what would be a standard AI-tool landing into a financial-broadsheet feel. Used at 36-66px for hero/section headlines and at 20-30px for subheadings.

inter.$description: All functional UI: body, nav, buttons, inputs, badges, footers. Carries the system's information while the serif does the emotional work. Uppercase eyebrows at 12-14px with +0.14em tracking are the consistent section-opener pattern.
